segments.name: Professional
segments.description: Designs and sells professional turf maintenance, landscape and lighting, underground construction, snow and ice management, and agricultural products to professional users worldwide.
segments.evidence: We design professional turf maintenance; landscape and lighting; rental, specialty, and underground construction; snow and ice management; and agricultural products.

segments.name: Residential
segments.description: Provides residential yard and snow thrower products sold through mass retailers, hardware retailers, home centers, and online.
segments.evidence: We classify our operations into two reportable business segments: Professional and Residential.

revenueModel.text: The company is paid by distributors, dealers, mass retailers, hardware retailers, equipment rental centers, and home centers, as well as online and direct end-users, who buy or rent its equipment and irrigation products.
